source_row.rationale: Serum creatinine is a waste product of muscle metabolism primarily cleared by the kidneys through glomerular filtration. An elevated creatinine level is a key indicator of impaired kidney function, since reduced glomerular filtration rate leads to creatinine accumulation in the blood, warranting further renal function evaluation.
source_row.source_detail: Elevated Creatinine and Impaired Kidney Function
source_row.source_name: Clinical Laboratory Reference Standards — Serum Creatinine as a Renal Function Marker
